Serving gone bad old food
Jan 2020
Had a forest mushroom lasagna and it tasted like old oil gone bad. While food was still warm, it was okayish as I was really starving, although I noticed on the 1st bite. I also didn’t want to spoil a romantic brunch with my partner. But then I just couldn’t finish half of it as the taste just worsened. When returning the food and asking the staff when the lasagna was cooked and telling them it turned bad, I had no answer about when the food was cooked and was told it was the mushroom that tasted like that... staff asked me if I wanted another dish but then my trust for this place was definitely broken (from a previous visit already). My partner had the egg Benedict and the bread wasn’t fresh. Yes it was baked, but you could still taste it wasn’t fresh. The Vietnamese coffee was really bad and so tasteless I can’t believe they charge so much (65k vnd or so). They eventually charged me the whole lasagna, which is so pretentious not to say unacceptable. I had a bad experience on their branch in D1 with a key lime pie that was so hard it would stick on my fork when I tried to cut it, probably at least a week old or frozen for I prefer not to know how long. That time I wasn’t charged since I didn’t bother tasting the food, hence no reviews about it. L’Usine has really gone so bad over the years and it started when the original owners sold it. The actual L’Usine now got my 1st ever one star review. Congratulations.
